title: TodoMVC: two test sentences rewritten after Kane missed bugs its own screenshots showed (official Web Components build)

rewrite.label: Web Components (official)
rewrite.framework: Official TodoMVC Web Components example (tastejs/todomvc, commit ff43b02)

agent.portPrompt: Port the legacy TodoMVC app in {legacyDir} (jQuery + Handlebars) to React 19 + TypeScript, built with Vite, in the current directory. Keep the same look (reuse its CSS) and the same behaviour, so users don't notice the switch. Set Vite's base to './' so `npm run build` writes a static site to dist/. Don't add features. Finish when `npm install` and `npm run build` succeed.

note: Kane passed two of the jQuery app's tests on builds that break them, although its own screenshots show the bugs: the ES6 build puts new todos at the top (#2311), and the Web Components build adds an empty row with “1 item left!” for a spaces-only entry (#2314). The sentences named the item and counted titles, so a wrong position and an untitled row slipped through. These two rewritten sentences say where the new todo goes and that no row or counter appears; each must pass on the jQuery app first.
